--DROP TABLE [OM].[OM_TASKS]

CREATE TABLE [OM].[OM_TASKS](
	[TASK_ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	[STREAM_ID] INT NULL,
	[TASK_NAME] [varchar](100) NULL,
	DATA_LAYER [VARCHAR](100),
	[SCHEMA_NAME] [varchar](20) NULL,
	[TABLE_NAME] [varchar](100) NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](100) NULL,	
	[DESCRIPTION] [varchar](1000) NULL,
	[UPDATE_DATETIME] [datetime] NULL,
	[CREATE_DATETIME] [datetime] NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_OM_TASKS PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ([TASK_ID] ASC) NOT ENFORCED)

select * from [OM].[OM_TASKS] order by 1
